Orthonormality makes a fixed vector have fixed coefficients; it does not exclude adding a nonzero vector in the orthogonal complement. The original proof therefore omitted coefficient-to-vector uniqueness, and its Statement incorrectly limited use of completeness to ladder domains. Repaired step 1.1 by showing every difference with the prescribed coefficients is orthogonal to the complete Hermite family and hence zero; corrected only the explanatory Statement paragraph.
